ValidationRule.description: #21199-Can not modify Servicing District/Market field once an Opportunity is Won #21309 - Added Bypass logic for users with Edit Servicing Region in Late Stage Opp permission set #24480 -making applicable for all record type
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( IM_Servicing_Region__c ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed')), NOT( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName), '4 - Negotiate') ),
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin',
NOT( $Permission.Edit_Servicing_Region_in_Late_Stage_Opp ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Servicing District cannot be updated in Stage 5/6/7. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
